chunks: And by this chain, it is that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Do not leave the crucified one after three days until you get him down, so he would be buried.

key_terms.الْمَصْلُوبَ: The crucified one (object of the verb)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling regarding how long a crucified person should be left exposed before burial?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the Sunnah of timely burial for the crucified, ensuring that even those subjected to public humiliation are restored to dignity within three days. It reflects the Shia emphasis on preserving the honor of the deceased and serves as a practical legal basis for the duration of exposure before burial.
